decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster builds directly on the firm's core coolant management knowledge, so in-house R&D can interpret its market results and improve it, and its continued website presence signals ongoing commitment.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge extends the firm's established filtration expertise, a domain where its absorptive capacity is high and which fits its sustainability-oriented coolant strategy.
Scraper belt chip conveyors sit at the heart of the firm's conveying competence and remain listed, so the firm can readily assimilate customer feedback and refine the product.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's metalworking material-flow offering, rely on knowledge it already holds, and stayed on the website in 2024, which supports retention.
